Name: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 (ISMS) for OCI
Description: International standard for Information Security Management Systems (ISMS) across Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).

Requirements.Name: A.5.15 Access Control & Compartment Segregation
Requirements.Description: Rules to control physical and logical access to information and other associated assets shall be established and implemented.

Requirements.Name: A.5.16 Identity Management & Credential Lifecycle
Requirements.Description: The full lifecycle of identities shall be managed including password policies and key rotation.

Requirements.Name: A.5.17 Authentication Information & Multi-Factor Authentication
Requirements.Description: Allocation and management of authentication information shall be controlled through MFA enforcement.

Requirements.Name: A.8.1 User Endpoint Devices & Compute Hardening
Requirements.Description: Information stored on, processed by or accessible via user endpoint devices and compute instances shall be protected.

Requirements.Name: A.8.7 Protection Against Malware & Threat Detection
Requirements.Description: Protection against malware and security threats shall be implemented using Oracle Cloud Guard.

Requirements.Name: A.8.8 Management of Technical Vulnerabilities
Requirements.Description: Information about technical vulnerabilities of information systems in use shall be obtained and evaluated.

Requirements.Name: A.8.12 Data Leakage Prevention & Storage Security
Requirements.Description: Data leakage prevention measures shall be applied to systems, networks, and object storage buckets.

Requirements.Name: A.8.13 Information Backup & Redundancy
Requirements.Description: Backup copies of information, software and system images shall be taken and tested regularly.

Requirements.Name: A.8.15 Logging & 365-Day Audit Trail Retention
Requirements.Description: Logs that record activities, exceptions, faults and other relevant events shall be produced, stored, protected and analyzed.

Requirements.Name: A.8.20 Network Security & VCN Boundary Controls
Requirements.Description: Networks and network devices shall be secured, managed and controlled to protect the information in systems and applications.

Requirements.Name: A.8.24 Use of Cryptography & Key Management
Requirements.Description: Rules for the effective use of cryptography, including cryptographic key management, shall be defined and implemented.
